summary: TOOL-4 Filter products by category and brand
description:
As a customer, I want to filter so I can narrow down the catalogue.

* Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
* Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
* Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
* Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

criteria.text: Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

cases.title: Selecting one category shows only that category's products
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page open with no filters applied; <a category that contains at least two products> exists, and at least one product outside that category exists.
steps: Note the products listed with no filters applied.
cases.expected: Only products from the selected category appear; products belonging to other categories are no longer listed.

cases.title: Selecting two categories shows products from both
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page open with no filters applied; <two categories that each contain at least one product> exist, plus at least one product in a third category.
steps: Also select the second category <category B>.
cases.expected: Products from both selected categories appear in the list; products from neither category are not listed.

cases.title: Combining a category and a brand shows only products matching both
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page open with no filters applied; <a category and a brand that share at least one product>, plus a product in that category from a different brand, and a product of that brand in a different category.
cases.expected: Only products that are in the selected category and of the selected brand appear; the same-category/other-brand product and the same-brand/other-category product are not listed.

cases.title: Unchecking all filters returns the full list
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page open; <a category and a brand that each have at least one product> exist; the unfiltered full product list is known.
steps: Record the full product list with no filters applied.
Select the category <the chosen category> and the brand <the chosen brand> and confirm the list is narrowed.
Uncheck the brand filter so no filters remain selected.
cases.expected: The full product list returns — the same products as recorded in step 1.

cases.title: Category and brand combination with no matching products
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page open with no filters applied; <a category and a brand that have no product in common> exist.
steps: Select the brand <the brand with no product in that category>.
cases.expected: No products are listed, since only products matching both filters appear. Any empty-result message or wording is not specified in the story.
